comentario: Our stay at Zoho Skies was fairly good overall. The accommodations matched the photos, were clean, and offered plenty of space for two people. That said, there were a few aspects of our stay that were mildly disappointing. First, there is no actual “hot tub.” The rooftop pool is not heated, and we were told by other guests that there is no hot tub on the property. Second, the shared BBQ was not available during our stay. These two amenities were key reasons we chose this location. In addition, there was a significant leak under the sink, which we reported to the team. While it was addressed, the repair took place around 10 p.m. rather than while we were out, which was inconvenient. Finally, and perhaps most disappointing, when we asked for an additional roll of toilet paper (after being provided three rolls), we were told we would need to purchase our own because the amount given was considered the “average” for a six-night stay.

We were also charged for parking, was supposed to be refunded, still waiting. Getting from the parking lot to the room required 2 elevators and was a long walk, taking 7-10 minutes, depending on the parking availability. Also, it says it’s a waterfront property, which the back of the property is on a canal, not ocean. For our five-night stay, we were initially provided with only one bath towel, one face cloth, and one hand towel, with no laundry detergent, requiring us to purchase supplies. Toilet paper was limited, shampoo and dish soap were below half full, and the patio had only three chairs (The unit sleeps 6) Our initial experience was disappointing, especially as first-time visitors to Bucerías.

There is only two chairs to sit in by the tv which made it difficult to lounge or play games as a group. We found the kitchen fairly well equipped but would have preferred to have some coffee filters and oil, which we picked up. The beach access is nice. There is a restaurant with limited hours on the roof otherwise not many places in walking distance to eat. Best to uber to Bucerias to eat out or to get groceries. solo faltaría agregar una licuadora, y arreglar el ruido que hace el split en la recámara grande. Saludos.

No safe was a big problem the bedrooms in the morning were so hot even with the a/c goin the shower doors were a little difficult to close being a bigger guy smaller bed was hard as a rock patio door locks need to be lubed struggled to lock them
El tema del colchón es el único detalle ya que olía a humedad y era insoportable! No lo pudimos usar!

Hola Rodrigo, La verdad nos quedamos un poco decepcionados con la estancia ya que estaba el lugar muy descuidado y sucio. Los pies nos quedaban negros de caminar descalzos, había platos en el lavavajillas, los cajones en el clóset principal estaban llenos de polvo, las paredes y las camas tienen manchas, la hielera estaba rota, y la secadora estaba llena de pelusa en el filtro, las puertas para salir al patio no se podían abrir o cerrar por pesadas y rotas. También fuimos a visitar an mis abuelos a Vallarta de muy lejos y no sabíamos que ni siquiera podían entrar al restaurante entonces no pudimos pasar mucho tiempo en Aria por lo mismo. Hay que ser más claros en la descripción donde dice que no se aceptan visitas ni al restaurante por ningún motivo. También pedimos por aquí que si nos ayudaban con la puerta de afuera y con más jabon para el cuerpo y no vino nadie a checarlo. Gracias.

The stay overall was good. The bad part was upon arrival the living room sofas were very stained and dirty. Then when we went into our room and turned on the A/C there was a huge leak from bathroom ceiling. It was terrible experience. They fixed it on day two.

HOLA Me gusto todo lo referente al departamento, todo funciona excelente lugar, pero si por favor que se tengan unas buenas ollas limpias había dos sartenes que estaban con cochambre por dentro :) Pues se trato de limpiar lo mas que se pudo, pero pues uno como mamá es mas quisquilloso Un poco más de limpieza, verificar que sirvan los controles, en el caso de nosotros nos diste la atención de las pilas rápidamente, muchas gracias Pero aun así el control de la tele no funciono, por lo cual bajamos el control en el celular y así pudimos solucionarlo, para no estar mandando mensaje. De ahí en mas todo excelente , gracias

la casa la califico al 100, pocos detalles de mantenimiento la fuga del baño de abajo fueron y la arreglaron, el baño del tercer piso una pequeña fuga en el lavabo en el desagüe, un control del aire acondicionado aveces no manda señal para prender, y como 4 focos fundidos
“La ubicación aparece desplazada más de 500mts”

The apartment is in a great location. Has access to the beach and great views to the ocean. The place was also dirty (stains on the floor, dirty mirrors and dirty mats in the bathrooms). The place was very dusty. The apartment is not properly maintained. There was no hot water and the stove did not work properly. Check in was at 3pm and the cleaning people were still there when we showed up at 4pm.
Rodrigo fue un excelente anfitrión. El departamento tenía todo lo necesario. La cocina y cuartos muy cómodos. Había suficientes toallas lo que resultaba muy cómodo sobre todo con niños pequeños.
El departamento muy limpio y muy bonito
Excelente todo, 100% recomendable!

Departamento muy bonito y elegante! Lo recomiendo ampliamente, está muy equipado y se encuentra muy cerca de supermercados, oxxo, de playas que cuentan con estacionamientos y lo mejor es que se encuentra en una zona para descansar cómodamente.
El departamento está igual de bonito que en las fotos, la comunicación y atención siempre fue muy buena y tanto las áreas del condominio como la playa son ideales para disfrutar🌅
Todo me pareció excelente en la estadía
Excelente lugar para descansar las instalaciones muy agradables, paz y tranquilidad. Con gusto regresaría
The condo is in a nice location downtown PV. Nothing negative to mention with the exception of the noise which is to be expected downtown. Would definitely rent again!

Overall, a nice place. And priced well. Just a bit further out than I would have preferred. We drove back into Puerto Vallarta several times for excursions. Main issue was power outage when we arrived to the property. It was hot and we didn’t have air-conditioning or lights for over seven hours. That made it very hard to get settled in on our first day. The host was responsive however, my food that spoiled was not refunded therefore, I lost time and money while on vacation. Good customer service would not have questioned me and taken care of my concern. The complex was beautiful and people were friendly. I would have loved a Jacuzzi though. The pools were plentiful. The beach area was fun for the kids. We had a great vacation in Mexico. I think I would just choose a location closer to Puerto Vallarta next time!
Muy bien la estancia, lo único es que el acceso principal no nos lo dieron desde un principio.
Todo está muy bonito como en las fotos , el departamento tiene todo para hacer la estancia muy agradable, cada detalle está pensado en los huéspedes, gracias Rodrigo por tus excelentes atenciones
Excelente lugar tranquilo y exclusivo
A nice clean apartment in a clean building. 24hr front desk so very safe.
Muy bonito lugar, muy tranquilo y el agua de la alberca muy calientita!
Excelente ubicación y estancia
tanto el departamento como las instalaciones todo excelente ya van 2 veces que vamos a ese complejo lo recomiendo

Nos encanta hospedarnos en el Grand Venetian y pasar unos días tranquilos en Vallarta. En temporada baja vale mucho la pena porque disfrutas de las instalaciones y la vista espectacular que tiene. Sin duda es un placer regresar. La atención ha sido muy buena.
Very responsive host. Good communication. We had a very nice vacation. This place is perfect for a family. You had to be very early to get loungers by the pool.
Depa muy bonito

Spacious, clean, and comfortable apartment in a beautiful and interesting complex. The landscaping was incredible, the multiple pool areas and lounge furniture were great, fast reliable WiFi, and the beach was pleasant and calm. Overall the setting feels nicer than other much more expensive hotel resorts nearby. Rodrigo, our host, was very helpful and super responsive. The restaurant in the complex was a little overpriced and the food and service were just average, but typical of a touristy area. They also automatically add a 20% tip to the check but then ask for an additional tip on top. Just a heads up that there is ongoing construction of several buildings (as of January 2026), and there is a lot of noise and construction site views which detract from the otherwise epic setting. There were also some unsupervised children who were allowed to be mildly rambunctious in the main pool area. None of this bothered us but just something to be aware of. Overall fantastic experience!
El lugar es muy agradable en general, perfectamente equipado con todo lo necesario, instalaciones bien mantenidas y una muy buena ubicación. Sin dudar, regresaríamos.
Everything about the service was outstanding. Always available and proactive. Building staff quickly knew our names and were attentive to everything.

Rodrigo’s condo was beautiful. The views off all the decks were amazing. Condo had everything we needed - beach towels, cooler bag, chairs and everything you could need for the kitchen. Beds were comfy. Linens were nice. The water cooler was unexpected , we did have to ask for water jugs to be brought. Daniela was quick to get them to us though. Location was perfect. Near lots of restaurants and a mall. Uber is super cheap to get you to airport or Malecon. The only negative was the Housecleaner. Check in was at 3. We arrived at 3. She was still cleaning which wasn’t an issue. But she was angry at us and gave us attitude. We sat on the deck until she was done. She left the other guests garbage in the suite for us to deal with and all the towels etc in the dryer. When we checked out, same bad attitude. Not necessary. I would definitely stay at the Grand Venetian again. It’s safe, clean and has all the amenities of a large resort. Restaurant on site has lots of reasonable options
Great place, would love to return
Excelente estancia! Todo perfecto
Gorgeous view of the bay, we saw whales, cruise ships, fireworks. The big balcony and sliding doors makes the place very pleasant and spacious. Clean and well equipped. Responsive host.

Beautiful location! The view was wonderful and it was great listening to the ocean waves. The condo itself was very clean. It had all of the listed amenities. The kitchen was well stocked with equipment and utensils. The AC worked very well. They were flexible with check in time since we were moving from one Airbnb to another and were helpful with that aspect.

Place is very clean, beautiful, kind host, the front reception is nice. If you like marinas, this place is perfect. It’s a very modern and beautiful airbnb. There were 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a kitchen, and makes it ideal for 2 sets of couples. Please note, this property in Marina Vallarta lacks public access to the beach, so a drive/car ride to old town vallarta (Playa de Oro) is required for easier access.
lugar muy agradable, cómodo y bonito... muy recomendable

Overall an excellent stay. The heated pool (32 degrees!) and the excellent gym were extra perks. Clean unit and lots of space. The issues: quite a lot of noise from the street/marina area at night. We had a lot of issues with getting into the building itself (not the unit). Apparently there is 24/7 security but they were often not at the main desk to let you into the building so you have to sit and wait for them to return to gain access to the building. We would have appreciated more comfortable seating both on the balcony and at the dining table. They overall were fairly responsive and dealt with issues quickly.

No tuve una buena experiencia 😩 ya que cuando ingresé a la habitación no habían hecho la limpieza y esto retrasó la entrega hasta después de las 6pm. Lo cual si fue muy molesto. Y el día de mi salida antes de las 11hrs. El personal de limpieza y con mala actitud ingresaron a la habitación indicando que la salida era antes de las 11hrs. Y luego me llamó quien estaría como anfitrión para indicarme que ya estaba el personal de limpieza y que ya tenía que dejar la habitación, indicándome lo que tienen que hacer después de que uno deja la habitación lo cual me pareció incongruente por el trato que yo recibí al recibir una habitación sucia después de las 18hrs.
Todo excelente! el lugar, la ubicación, del departamento, todo! solo me gustaría incluir que si vas en carro lleves una sombrilla porque son insuficientes en el área de alberca y playa!
SUPER RECOMENDABLE PARA DESCANSAR EN FAMILIA

Excelente estancia, el cuarto padrísimo, impecable todo, dejan shampoo, acondicionador, jabones y toallas de más y eso se agradece. No cuenta con lavadora y secadora. Lo único malo, (que no tiene nada que ver con el anfitrión o el cuarto) Es que el hotel no tiene estacionamiento y lo tienes que dejar afuera del edificio, que aunque es seguro, es pura terracería y tienes que encontrar lugar porque todos los dejan ahí, Otra cosa, es que no te puedes meter a la playa porque es pura piedra, tendrías que caminar a lado del hotel, a la playa pública. De ahí en más todo es perfecto en el hotel y con los anfitriones.

It's a beautiful house, beautiful views. We really enjoyed our stay. We were visiting because we attended a wedding in the area and we were busy with family and friends, we did not spend much time on the house. But we really enjoyed the little time we were there. I wish a could stay longer.

We enjoyed our stay here, the place is clean and comfortable. Rodrigo was very helpful and responsive, allowed us to drop off some. Luggage before check in. Rooftop is very nice and never got too busy. We loved the location and would happily stay at Rodrigos place again.
The place has plenty of space for a large family. there are plenty of rooms and a very large living room area. it feels safe and well cared for
Muy buen establecimiento es primera vez que vamos y todo muy bien, buena ubicación y todo en tranquilidad

El depa es igualito que las fotos, es muy bonito ideal para pasar tiempo con la familia. Considera tener carro para ir al club de playa ya que la subida está pesadita, las albercas son increíbles. Rodrigo en general fue muy atento respondiendo nuestras dudas. Sin duda alguna regresaré

Excdlente departamento de 4 recámaras con todo lo necesario para una estancia perfecta en N Vallarta. Muy buena decoración y accesorios y utensilios de gran calidad. Acceso a la playa caminando y con todas las amenidades y tiendas de la zona muy cerca. El condominio es muy tranquilo y agradable. Cuenta con varias amenidades ideales para chicos y grandes. La atención de los hosts muy buena en todo momento. Súper recomendable.
This is my 2nd time coming back - Location was great ! beautiful view - Spacious living room and kitchen

We had an excellent stay at this beautiful condo with spectacular facilities. The appartement was as shown in the photos and had all the essentials. The on-site amenities - beach, pools, restaurant, gym and games room were all pristine and we had no trouble finding available loungers at any time of the day. Staff was very friendly. The beach was great. We also had excellent, and quite inexpensive massages at the condo spa. The only downside is that there isn't much at a walking distance (though there is a mini market and a pharmacy), and we ended up renting a car as ubers and taxis tended to be expensive and not always easy to get. But the many restaurants of Bucerias and Nuevo Nayarit are just a 15 min drive. Rodrigo and the team were friendly but sometimes took a while to respond and the concierge service did not work for us over the weekend (though I think due to illness..)

The Condo new and very large with a private pool. The complex was wonderful with multiple pools and foliage was amazing. The beach was just perfect and not very busy. The restaurant was very good and the staff excellent. There was also the lighthouse restaurant which was a little expensive but the food and views were amazing with great sunset.

El departamento está impecable, súper funcional, limpio y cómodo. Los hosts tuvieron excelente comunicación todo el tiempo. Mi experiencia fue excelente y no tengo ningún comentario. Definitivamente es un lugar familiar, muy bonito, restaurantes con comida muy rica y muy linda playa. Lo recomiendo mucho. Mi única observación sería la administración del edificio, aún respetando el reglamento el acoso fue excesivo e incómodo.
My family’s third time staying at Rodrigo’s place. The apartment is very spacious and is perfect for our family. We will be back!
Todo muy bien, se nos olvidó algo en el lugar y muy amablemente nos ayudaron y seguimos en contacto. Definitivamente volveríamos, gracias.
Excellente alojamiento, muy cómodo y bonito🌸

This place is a hidden gem with barely any tourist, which is great! There is high security at the entrance so you feel safe. They do have a few restaurants and a coffee shop/cafe with a snack shop on site. They provided filtered water in unit and all drinks we had were made with purified ice and washed safely so no one got sick. This is a great spot for a quiet retreat with plenty of things to do on site.
Nice and private
Gran lugar para descansar y disfrutar de la playa y clima de Punta Mita

El lugar estaba increíble! incluso mejor que en las fotos. Las personas del condominio fueron muy amables y serviciales, y las amenidades fueron excelentes, realmente disfrutamos la estancia. Sin embargo, la comunicación con los hosts fue el punto débil. Tardaban mucho en responder, no resolvieron todas nuestras dudas y tuvimos una situación incómoda durante el proceso de reserva. Les preguntamos si podíamos volver a reservar desde otra cuenta para usar un voucher manteniendo el precio original, nos confirmaron que sí, pero al hacerlo el precio había aumentado y no quisieron respetar lo acordado.
El lugar agradable, acogedor, limpio, cerca de Av Cocoteros, donde hay Clubs de Playa ademas de ser una zona bonita.

Bring binoculars for the incredible view! Lots of great things to see like whales and people watching from the 19th floor! We loved the location! The pools onsite were huge, clean, and great for all ages with lots of seating available. The beach access was very convenient and absolutely beautiful, equipped with chairs and umbrellas as well. The staff were very helpful and friendly. Rodrigo was very attentive and responsive. We really enjoyed the restaurant onsite (can order lots of great food and drink options to your door, poolside, or at the beach). It could have been a little better maintained (wall scratches, chipped paint, mildew in bathrooms) like others have mentioned but overall not bad enough to make them come clean it or anything, overall clean and nice! Newer appliances. Toilet had an issue but Daniel's team fixed it quickly! We also lost our beach key and Daniel got us a new one quick! We were very happy and would 100% stay here again if we come back! Thanks!
The condo was great, beautifully decorated and close to lots of shops and restaurants. The beach is only a 5 min walk away. Would stay here again.
Fue una hermosa experiencia, una casa espectacular muy amplia y tranquila y cerca del centro de Mascota para ir y venir a pie.
The place is a very nice condo and I highly recommend booking here . We enjoyed it
Beautiful location and such a great stay! Can’t wait to go back!

We had a good stay, the pools and beach were really nice and the reason we came here! The beach is a bit of a walk from the condo but the jungle atmosphere made it a nice walk. The condo was supplied with everything you need. We did have an issue with the shower pressure in one of the bathrooms for our entire stay but seems like it was resolved after we left.

El complejo en el que se encuentra el departamento está súper bonito. Tienen 3 albercas muy grandes, acceso directo a la playa, palapas en la playa, seguridad, un restaurente, así como servicio de bebidas y alimentos en la alberca. El departamento está muy bonito. Tiene dos recámaras, aunque me parece que una de las habitaciones no tiene aire acondicionado. También tiene una terraza con vista al mar divina. ¡Muy recomendable!
excelente lugar para vacacionar un espacio muy relajante con una playa muy linda. 100% recomendable
Todo excelente, muy cómodo y limpio

This was a truly beautiful apartment, in a very lovely building. The building was well-located, near everything, but a little bit removed from the busiest areas. The rooftop area was very relaxing and enjoyable. The staff in the lobby were exceedingly helpful and friendly. We would definitely stay here again.

Mi estancia en el alojamiento de Rodrigo fue increíble. El departamento tiene todo lo necesario y esta ubicado en una excelente zona de Nuevo Vallarta. La zona es segura y la playa esta muy cerca en carro. Sin duda alguna volvería a hospedarme en este alojamiento. La atención de Rodrigo fue muy buena y las instrucciones para llegar a instalarme fueron muy fáciles y claras. Muchas gracias por todo Rodrigo y equipo!
Tudo muito bom mesmo! Eu e minha familia pretendemos voltar.
El departamento es bonito como en las fotos y tienes muchas amenidades cerca, me gustó mucho y lo recomiendo
Excelente atención el lugar limpio y ordenado me encantó

El departamento está como lo describen. Nos costó un poco encontrarlo pero después todo estuvo increíble. La alberca está climatizada y eso es bueno para nadar temprano o noche. Además de que te ga dos baños completos está súper. si podría quedarme ahí otra vez
Excelente lugar, muy agradable la piscina y muy cerca de la playa
Muy lindo lugar
Nice place, affordable, and clean. great location. Very convenient building consierge for luggage drop off.

Tuvimos una estancia fantástica. El alojamiento es muy acogedor y la experiencia fue muy agradable de principio a fin. Destaco especialmente la atención del anfitrión, quien se comunicó en todo momento para asegurarse de que no nos faltara nada. ¡Gracias por todo!

Nuestra estancia fue excelente! Fue mejor que en las fotos, nos encantó sin duda volveríamos. El departamento coincide con la descripción; las camas cómodas, sala grande, comedor amplio, baños limpios, juegos de mesa, artículos de cocina, toallas suficientes, acceso fácil. El lugar tiene unas albercas con vistas increíbles, la mayoría climatizadas; la playa privada es muy bonita también. Hay restaurante y cafetería: lo que recomendamos es el sushi y si no se quiere consumir ahí es necesario llevar pues no hay tiendas cerca. La comunicación con el anfitrión muy clara, el personal del lugar amable y atento. Se pagan $100 por persona (totalmente vale la pena) te permite disfrutar las amenidades. Ambiente familiar, privado y moderno.
Me encantó el depa, todo el condominio está hermoso. Súper recomendado 10000/10 ! La comida que venden en el restaurante está deliciosa y el precio es bueno.
Excelente anfitrión y excelente ubicación, recomendado ampliamente. 👍🏻
Si quieres un lugar para descansar este alojamiento es ideal ya que todo el lugar es muy tranquilo y las instalaciones están muy bonitas, recomendable al 100%

Los Tules is a large ocean-front condominium complex that includes seven swimming pools and a long stretch of beach, all surrounded by well-kept grounds with lush vegetation. It is quiet and relaxing and separated from the hustle and bustle of PV, although PV is very accessible right outside the fenced walls of the property. Rodrigo's condo is in a very nice part of the complex with views of the ocean and sunsets right from the patio. We found everything very comfortable and just as described in the listing. Rodrigo and Daniel were great to communicate with and helped with any issues that came up. As others have pointed out, the unit is on the fourth floor and is accessed by several sets of stairs (including a tight spiral staircase within the unit itself), so if you have problems climbing stairs, this unit is probably not for you. However, the stairs did not bother us and we had a great time staying there. We would not hesitate to go back and stay there again.

El departamento Excelente, todo súper recomendable, el anfitrión siempre al pendiente, muy cómodo, muy detallistas. En cuestión del complejo Aria batallamos con el tema de los elevadores, no funcionaban, tuvimos que bajar los 10 pisos con maletas por las escaleras. No es cuestión del departamento, sino del complejo que tienen estas fallas en el elevador muy seguido Fuera de ello, todo recomendable (5 estrellas)
Great place. Thanks Rodrigo!
Todo muy excelente, la estancia increíble!!!
Súper bonito lugar y muy cómodo!

Jusr needed a decent place to stay near the hospital. Fine for business. Nice courtyard and pool. Missing lightbulbs made living area a bit dark. No big complaints as spacious but wouldn’t suggest it for dream vacation in Mexico.
It was great staying here, host was very responsive.

“Un lugar excelente si lo que buscas es descansar y desconectar de todo.” El departamento, es muy cómodo y te hace sentir como en casa. Sin duda alguna es un lugar increíble, que te da todo lo que ofrece y más en cuanto a la atención por parte de los anfitriones. Claro que regresaría si me lo preguntaran.
Nice place
muy agradable la casa 🏡 excelente vista

We have stayed in many of the condos at grand Venetian. This was our favorite. It had beautiful views from every window! Both bedroom suites were lovely, it was well stocked, they provided water and basic spices, nice cooking, utensils, great balcony, good Wi-Fi, just all the things that you want for a good Airbnb experience! Really appreciated that we were able to pay a little fee and stay until late checkout! Also, Pickleball is now offered! The host are fabulous and very helpful!

The home is beautiful and comfortable, but the surroundings are what sets this place apart! It is in a developed complex called Kovay Gardens where the condos are mostly hidden by lush tropical plants and trees. It was a delight walking through the complex each day on winding paths that led to different pools, some heated, some cooled. There are hot tubs and shallow pools of water available along the way as well. Each body of water is nestled among beautiful tropical plants. The beach is large and clean. The bay was warm and calm when we visited in January. The complex is very relaxing and was extremely quiet when we were there. Some families with young kids, but mostly older couples. Get groceries before you arrive. Food is good in complex but prices are equivalent to what you’d pay in USA. There’s a good local taco place across the street, or a 20 minute walk along beach to town for local restaurants. Tree House is great, or Masala for something more upscale.

Had a great time staying at Rodrigo's place with the family. Pool and close by beach across was fun for the kids. Very close drive into Puerto Vallarta and the small fishing towns to the south. Highly recommend.

Nice place to stay and plenty of room. Great views and the washer/dryer came in handy. The showers are very small and awkward but not a deal breaker. It's the perfect location for those who like the marina or want to be close to the airport.

Excelente penthouse: muy cómodo, moderno y perfectamente cuidado. La vista es espectacular y la ubicación inmejorable, en una zona tranquila y segura. Sin duda una experiencia increíble, totalmente recomendable.

Un lugar increible para descansar, el acceso bien, el departamento muy bonito, todo limpio, los utencilios de la cocina super bien, las recamaras bien y muy comodas, el lugar tiene varias albercas muy bien ubicadas con agua climatizada, hay restaurantes y la comida esta rica, la zona de playa super comoda, el personal super amable, nuestra estancia fue 10 de 10, volveriamos sin pensarlo.
Alojamiento súper bonito con todo lo necesario, buenos anfitriones y el servicio del condominio está muy completo, 100% recomendado.

This is a perfect location on the beach with an incredible view. The place was actually much bigger in person than the pictures looked to me. The top floor deck was also a huge bonus. There is also a restaraunt, mini store, and spa with very fair prices in the resort compound. Made the trip relaxing and enjoyable. Overall area was very convenient with mall/grocery store across the street. The place is worth booking and will stay here again in the future. Also notably had great water pressure and plenty of hot water, which if you visit Mexico, you know that isn’t always the case. So this place checked all the boxes for me!
Very nice stay. Clean condo. Only drawback was being close to Highway 200. Heard traffic at night when we slept

Bolongo, en Punta de Mita, fue un viaje relajante y divertido, perfecto para disfrutar en familia: mi esposa, mis tres hijas, mi nieta y mi yerno. El entorno invita a bajar revoluciones y convivir sin prisas, con espacios pensados para eso… y la terraza, simplemente espectacular, de esas que hacen que el café dure más de lo planeado. Hubo un detalle técnico: el sistema hidráulico falló y sábado y domingo no tuvimos agua caliente. No fue ideal, pero tampoco opacó la experiencia. En general, todo estuvo muy acorde con el precio, lo cual siempre se agradece cuando uno viaja con expectativas realistas y familia numerosa. Conclusión: un lugar muy recomendable para descansar, convivir y disfrutar buenas vistas, con uno que otro ajuste técnico que vale la pena afinar… porque el escenario ya hace gran parte del trabajo.

La ubicación fue perfecta. No tiene acceso a la playa; tiene varias amenidades. Lo que no me gustó es que jo tenía suficiente jabón de manos y jabón para el cuerpo. Siento q le falta que profundicen la limpieza sobre todo en el área de cocina y baño. De lo demas está bien.

Me gustó mucho el Depto, está muy bien equipado muy bien amueblado, no tuve ningún problema en encontrarlo. Hay muchas restaurantes alrededor que puedes ir caminando. Lo único retirado es la playa si no traes un automóvil
Excelente anfitrión el departamento estuvo increíble
Excelente departamento a pie de playa
El departamento tiene una vista espectacular, agradable la estancia muy tranquilo, algunos detalles del apartamento pero nada q no se solucione Rodrigo muy amable en todo momento
Todo en orden, buena ubicacion, los oficiales de la entrada súper amables.

El lugar tiene extraordinaria vista a la bahía y a la marina. Se ven ballenas con binoculares. Todo limpio y coincide con las fotos El descanso puede mejorar bastante, tuvimos la no agradable situación que los filtros de agua, encendían para hacer algún proceso a las 3am y así durante 1 hora haciendo un ruido incomodo. Bien pudiera hacerse ese proceso en horario diurno pero jamás nocturno, ojalá no les ocurra a los siguientes visitantes. Se hizo el comentario al anfitrión pero no respondió al cuestionamiento de manera concreta.

La ubicación y las amenidades son muy buenas, y el departamento en general está bien. Sin embargo, se nota un poco descuidado. En el baño de la habitación principal había humedad y moho, el sofá cama estaba sucio y con mal olor, al igual que las sábanas, y en la cocina encontramos comida olvidada dentro del microondas. un excelente, lugar ideal para compartir con amigos y familia. cada área del lugar es exactamente como se describe.

We really enjoyed our stay in this apartment in the Los Tules area. The unit itself had all the amenities we needed and was very comfortable, with lots of space to relax. We made breakfast once or twice and especially enjoyed the balcony overlooking the pool and the ocean — a great spot to start or end the day. The kitchen was well equipped, and the blender came in handy for frozen margaritas, which was a nice bonus. The location worked very well for us: steps from the beach and just a few blocks from several of our favorite restaurants. We were a little concerned about the stairs before arriving, but they turned out to be no issue at all — only two floors up, plus a small staircase inside the apartment, and honestly a bit of welcome exercise. Overall, a very pleasant stay and a place we’d be happy to return to.

We absolutely loved the location of this building. Wonderful pool for children. Located right on the beach. We enjoyed walking a couple minutes for softer sand and fun waves. We visited in January and saw countless whales and dolphins right from our balcony. Definitely a highlight. The city bus stops right outside building gate. We were traveling with small children and had no issues with the bus - great service for 10 pesos! The route also goes to Boca where you can get water taxis for alternative beaches. We highly recommend to anyone looking for a quiet, nature filled vacation.
Esta muy bien ubicado y tiene buenas opciones de comida cerca. Aparte de estar cerca y accesible a la playa. Quedamos encantados con el lugar.

El departamento es muy bonito, limpio y espacioso, exactamente como se muestra en las fotos. La playa es muy bonita y privada, lo cual es un gran plus; sin embargo, tiene piedras, lo que dificulta disfrutarla plenamente (sobre todo el día que había olas grandes) ya que es difícil nadar o caminar descalzo. En general, es una muy buena opción para una estancia cómoda y relajante, el acceso es muy fácil, el departamento está en primera planta, lo cual para nosotros fue muy cómodo, el estacionamiento prácticamente en frente del departamento y una excelente atención por parte de Rodrigo. El único detalle fue la playa, pero ya que hicimos actividades fuera por las mañanas y regresábamos a descansar al departamento fue una gran opción para nosotros.

The unit boasts a fully equipped kitchen. Most units have a BBQ on the unit's patio and that has been our experience in previous rentals. The beds in this unit were fantastic! very comfortable.

We enjoyed our 35 days in a new area of Mexico for us, Nuevo Vallarta. Our weather was perfect. Rodrigo & his team were very responsive to a couple small issues during our stay. There are a few things that need to be addressed. As mentioned in a previous review, there are certain items that need to be replaced, seating on balcony is not adequate for 6 people, absolutely NO cleaning products & little to none paper products. Broken beach umbrellas, rusted folding beach chairs. Only ONE key given in lock box for access to condo. Great restaurants within walking distance, the beach is approximately 10-15 mins walk. Just out front of the condo complex are plenty of local buses, small white vans with green writing are called Collectivo, they’ll take you locally to grocery stores, Chedraui & Sorianas, approximately 12 pesos. We wouldn’t return to this complex as the noise level was extremely loud. Above & below each unit are very thin walls & floors. You hear everything.
Great central location with restaurants and pubs on your door step. Rodrigo was very responsive and provided help when needed.

Great location in a secure building. Walkable to so many things. Quiet and tranquil. The pool is gorgeous! The place itself has some wear and tear and is minimally appointed but fine for a few days if you’re out in the town mostly.

Do NOT book this property unless you’re prepared for chaos and zero support. Yes, the apartment is beautiful — but everything else was a nightmare. I booked a month in advance and traveled from New York with teens. Despite FIVE hosts listed, not one provided proper assistance. Check-in instructions arrived AFTER check-in time. When we finally arrived at 9 pm, we were given the WRONG apartment and left waiting 30 minutes for access. One guest was denied entry until 11:15 pm due to poor registration handling. Security was useless. Elevator failures allowed strangers to walk directly into our apartment. We endured hours of loud music from next door. Parking was changed last minute and unavailable. The apartment had visible holes and unfinished paint. The owner repeatedly read messages and ignored them. This is a prime example of terrible management, zero accountability, and complete disregard for guests. A beautiful unit completely ruined by incompetence. Save yourself the stress
